changelog:
- Fixed Tab & Three-Dots Buttons Glitches: Permanently eliminated aggressive focus-within and text-folding hiding rules so that the tab counter and options menu buttons never disappear, glitch, or drop touch events.
- Complete Button Functionality & Empty States: Fixed Bookmarks & Saved dialog to always open immediately even when empty, providing an informative message rather than failing silently.
- Stable Command Bar & Menu Actions: Streamlined tap handling across all start-page action buttons, 4K visual hub, media video hub, and popover menu options.
